title: Change only the group of a file
summary: Use chown with a leading colon to change only the group ownership of a file, leaving the user owner unchanged. This often does not require sudo if you belong to the target group.

steps.explain: Use chown with a colon before the group name to change only the group. This works without sudo if you are a member of the target group.
